b2bSnowball.title: B2B Home IoT snowball research
b2bSnowball.label: Snowball research: from a hypothesis, through pilot interviews (US 9, Korea 6) and defining the research domains (stakeholders, devices and context, business logic), to a main study of US 25+16 and Korea 24+16 — the circles grow — leading to two opportunity areas: Korean smart apartments and US multifamily units
b2bSnowball.caption: Research process reconstructed for the portfolio

b2bStakeholdersUS.label: US multifamily stakeholder structure: under the investing owner, the developer is the key decision maker; architects, general contractors and property managers propose and advise, and property management connects to residents. Roles only, no company names
b2bStakeholdersUS.caption: Research findings reconstructed for the portfolio · roles only, no company or personal names

b2bStakeholdersKR.label: Korean apartment stakeholder structure: before sale, the constructor is the Home IoT decision maker, working with the developer or association, trust and finance, architect, subcontractors, home-network and telecom suppliers and the sales agency; after move-in, the residents' committee and management company run operations for residents. Roles only, no company names
b2bStakeholdersKR.caption: Research findings reconstructed for the portfolio · roles only, no company or personal names

aptResearch.narrow: Selected from survey → focus group → home visit
aptResearch.label: Research design: after a first pilot, the method was improved and more researchers added for a second usability study. At Raemian Leaders One, Songdo The Sharp Triple Tower and Hyochang Park Prugio, the same six steps ran — recruit, onboard, 3-day tasks, survey, focus groups, home visits — narrowing participants from survey to focus group to home visit. Each step had its own document written by the researcher
aptResearch.caption: Research process reconstructed for the portfolio · no research results or scores

rows.insight: Linking & onboarding is the biggest hurdle
Hard to picture when to use modes
Alerts get used only if on by default
Home screen is one long list

aptInsights.label: Insight-to-improvement map: simpler linking and preset modes and automation were applied; family sharing and member settings, alerts on by default, lighting groups and a restructured home screen are improvements derived from the research
aptInsights.caption: Research findings reconstructed for the portfolio · no research results or scores
